subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He wanted to buy some books, but his purse did not __permit__ that.
solution:
The solution is **grant**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in 'He wanted to buy some books, but his purse did not permit__ that.' is grant. 
 
• He wanted to buy some books, but his purse did not __grant____ __that.
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss synonyms of other options.
 
 
• **Warrant - **Authorization.

 
 
• ​For example : *There was no warrant for searching their house.* 
 
 
 
• **​​Patent - **Copyright.​​
 
 
• ​For example :* She issued a write for breach of copyright. *
 
 
 
• **​Tolerate - **Allow, Consume.
 
 
• ​For example : *How could you tolerate so much noise.*
